name: PT Homeco Victoria Makmur Tbk
summary: PT Homeco Victoria Makmur Tbk engages in the wholesale business in Indonesia. The company offers household equipment and supplies, stationery and pictures, drawing tools, children's games and toys, and textiles. It also provides kitchenware, drinking and dining utensils, cookware, stationery, wet wipes, travel products, and cosmetic packaging. It sells its products under the Technoplast, scandic, Le Cuisine, Wiggle, One Price, house of valenca, KEI, Unitei, KNTG, Portofino, Oliveo, teqnocook, Qinsto Living, HOUSZN, HomeCo CERAMICS, Moriihome, techno FUN, Maamo, Houzn and Cosse, Bergner, Berndes, Masterpro, San Ignacio, Moneta, LEKUE, Blaumann, KATA, Big block, scandic, United Colors of Benetton, TINY Treasure, On The Go, Royalty Line, schoolbites, t+, AOKI, COLORFUN, Loka, NEXT COFFEE, Lovelo, Metaltex, Monochrome, RCYCL, Ceravella, Cosse Living, klen, Medina, TLOCK, Azumi, fantastic, Mixy Cansiter, NOBANANA!, Coin Bank, and Kushiro brands. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Jakarta Barat, Indonesia.
